title: Dong-june Choi’s Personal Webpage
text:
Email: choi.1702@osu.edu
Office: Math building 412


Welcome! My name is Dong-june Choi and I am a graduate student at the Ohio State University math department. My academic advisor is Prof. Kenneth Koenig. I study several complex variables and harmonic analysis. I did my undergraduate work at POSTECH.

title: Research/Publication
text: I use harmonic analysis methods to solve problems in several complex variables. My thesis work deals with sharp \(L^p\) regularity of the Szegö projection on the Hartogs triangle. My other work is on topics within \(L^2\)-theory of several complex variables.
